verdict_rationale: Measured against 'Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the objects.': every target object ending in the dustpan's pan (c1) is derivable from sweeping with a dustpan. c2 (dustpan left flat) is hidden and latent; c3 (broom left well to the dustpan's right) and c4 (arm return) are hidden and active, so the record is instruction_incomplete. The base's first clause cannot be reused because it names three blocks; the variant scores a per-layout set of 3-6 bricks, earbuds and paper balls, so the rewritten clause names their kinds without a count.
semantic_contract: Every toy brick, earbud and crumpled paper ball on the table must end up inside the dustpan's pan, the shallow scoop in front of its handle, lying well within the pan's outline seen from above, toward its middle rather than at its edges or corners. If any one of them is left beside the dustpan, on its rim or on its handle, the task is not complete.
The dustpan must be left resting flat on the table the right way up, as it lay at the start: not lifted, held up, tipped onto its lip or propped on one of the swept objects or on the broom.

The broom must be left clearly to the right of the dustpan, farther toward world +X, the side of the table where the right arm is mounted; a broom left on the dustpan's left side, or only about level with it from left to right, does not count.
Both arms must be back at the poses they held when the episode reset, at the same instant that everything else in this contract is true.

review_notes: run_reward registers ONE check stage (sweep_blocks_random.py:21-36): is_A_on_B_left, is_not_lift, is_axis_up, an OR of two all-objects-in-pan tests over get_label_by_prefix('target'), and all_robot_back_to_origin. No query, trigger_check, final_check or get_score, so no permanent failure condition.

The scored set is fixed at reset: get_label_by_prefix runs inside run_reward, which the bridge registers once at reset, and returns the layout's target_* labels (layout 0: five). Unlabelled objects (none in this variant) and the camera stand are not scored.

MEANS NOT CHECKED, as in the base: no evaluator term reads the handover or whether objects were swept rather than placed; the instruction keeps the means and the contract neither restates nor negates it.
NO RELEASE TERM: no gripper check; with both arms home neither tool can still be held.
TAG NAME: the dustpan's 'handle' functional frames lie in the front part of the pan (base record's mesh probe of the same model 0); the public text says pan.

SIZE: the variant's objects are two to three times the base cubes' width, so fitting four to six centres into the scored region is a tighter packing problem than the base's three cubes; feasibility was not measured.
Earbuds are single earbuds (captions: Sony wireless earbud, black earbud, AirPod), not charging cases; bricks are Lego bricks; the public text calls them toy bricks, earbuds and crumpled paper balls.
